Title: Add Windows ARM64 CI support
Body:
This PR adds Windows ARM64 support to CI.

- **Wheels:** build `win_arm64` wheels natively on the `windows-11-arm` runner for releases (and pushes to `main`), alongside the existing Windows wheels.

Files (2): .github/workflows/python-distributions.yml, pyproject.toml

             macos_x86=$(echo -n "$macos_all" | tr ' ' '\n' | grep x86_64 | tail -1)
